lines.text: Can you send the new poster to the class? They need it before lunch.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Which file should I send? I see one with a photo and one with a map.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Use the one with the map. It shows the new room for Friday's class.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Got it. Should I send it by email or put it in the group chat?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Please put it in the group chat. A few people do not check email at work.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Do you want a short note with it, too?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Yes, please say that the class starts at the usual time.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Okay, I will send the map poster now and add a note about the time.
lines.speaker: Eli
